reason: Certified for exact WPForms Lite 2.0.1.1 on single-site WordPress within the reviewed authored settings, JSON form/template bodies, shortcode/block/widget references, native form-tag relationships, and the verified wpforms_form_locations reconstruction boundary. The capsule proves divergent-ID Apply, native settings/form/tag consumers, provider retry and fixed-point recapture, while preserving target-local credentials, Pro/addon/runtime/payment state. Form/template/tag deletion, QR browser authoring, submissions/mail, integrations, multisite, and unreviewed permalink or extension combinations remain explicit unsupported boundaries.

WPrism v1 refuses multisite before policy load; network settings and activation are outside this single-site adapter.

The certified boundary carries only Lite authored settings, bodies, references, tags, widgets and the reviewed derived location cache. Pro/addon fields, submissions, mail, integrations, payment/analytics/log/task tables and cloud enrollment remain target-local.
